extDescription.message: Shows every folder of the path in the Google Drive™ breadcrumb instead of hiding them behind "...", and copies the full path.

prefixLabel.message: Text to prepend to the path

prefixHelp.message: Prepended exactly as entered. For a folder path, include a trailing separator (/ on Mac, \ on Windows). Leave empty to add nothing.

separatorHelp.message: Placed between folder names. The text prepended to the path is not changed.

notFolderView.message: Open a folder in Google Drive to see its path.
